title: Wet-spun Ag/PZT/TPU composite piezoelectric fibers with ultrahigh flexibility: fabrication, performance, and sensing response
content:
RSC Adv., 2026, 16,14123-14134
DOI: 10.1039/D5RA09925K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution-NonCommercial 3.0 Unported Licence.
Wanwan Liu, Huabin Li, Jingjing Xu, Shuangquan Wu, Zhidong Chen
Through interfacial modification of PZT and in situ reduction of AgNPs, high-loading (>80 wt%) TPU piezoelectric fibers are fabricated via wet spinning. Ultrahigh flexibility and sensitivity make the fibers ideal for wearable self-powered sensors.
